title: Revolutionizing leishmaniasis control: leveraging immunoinformatics for precision-driven in-silico vaccine design.
authors: Ovais, Meeral; Kanwal, Munazza; Naz, Shumaila; Aziz, Tariq; Al-Hoshani, Nawal; Alwethaynani, Maher S; Abduljawad, Sahar; Asseri, Jamal I; Sagini, Hanan Abdulrahman; Alkhatib, Shaza N; Al-Joufi, Fakhria A; Jamal, Syed Babar
one_liner_zh: 该文利用免疫信息学设计利什曼病多表位疫苗，核心是蛋白-免疫受体互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Leishmaniasis is an endemic disease in many countries that affects vulnerable populations of humans, dogs, and cats. This study employs immunoinformatics to design a multi-epitope vaccine construct for leishmaniasis by identifying vaccine targets on the protein Pteridine Reductase. T-cell and B-cell epitopes were screened for antigenicity, toxicity, and allergenicity. Shortlisted T-cell targets were confirmed to have appropriate IC values (</= 50 nM and </= 500 nM for MHC I and MHC II, respectively). One B-cell epitope, six MHC class I epitopes, and 25 MHC class II epitopes were selected for inclusion in the vaccine construct, which was linked with EAAAK, CPGPG, and AAY linkers, along with a CPG Oligodeoxynucleotide adjuvant. The vaccine construct had a Ramachandran score of 89.9% and an Errat score of 98.4615. HLA alleles were predicted to produce an immune response in 81.8% of the global population, indicating encouraging potential for broad immunogenicity. Successful binding of the vaccine construct with TLR-9 was confirmed through molecular docking, and the docked complex exhibited a low eigenvalue of 2.06e-0.6 and a DeltaG of -11.8 kcal mol-1, indicating stable binding and a high level of flexibility. Codon optimization was carried out, followed by in-silico cloning of the vaccine in Escherichia coli K12 strain using the vector pET-21a (+). These results suggest that the vaccine is stable and capable of eliciting a promising immune response against Leishmania, making it a favorable candidate for experimental trials.
abstract_zh: 利什曼病是一种在许多国家流行的地方病，影响人类、狗和猫等脆弱群体。本研究采用免疫信息学方法，通过识别蝶啶还原酶 (Pteridine Reductase) 蛋白上的疫苗靶点，设计针对利什曼病的多表位疫苗构建体。对T细胞和B细胞表位进行了抗原性、毒性和过敏原性筛选。入围的T细胞靶点被确认具有适当的IC值（MHC I和MHC II分别</= 50 nM和</= 500 nM）。选择了一个B细胞表位、六个MHC I类表位和25个MHC II类表位纳入疫苗构建体，并通过EAAAK、CPGPG和AAY连接子连接，同时包含一个CPG寡脱氧核苷酸 (CPG Oligodeoxynucleotide) 佐剂。疫苗构建体的Ramachandran评分为89.9%，Errat评分为98.4615。预测HLA等位基因能在全球81.8%的人群中产生免疫反应，表明其具有广泛的免疫原性潜力。通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 确认了疫苗构建体与TLR-9的成功结合，对接复合体表现出低特征值2.06e-0.6和DeltaG为-11.8 kcal mol-1，表明结合稳定且具有高灵活性。进行了密码子优化，随后使用载体pET-21a (+)在大肠杆菌 (Escherichia coli) K12菌株中进行疫苗的计算机克隆。这些结果表明，该疫苗稳定且能够引发针对利什曼原虫的有前景的免疫反应，使其成为实验试验的有利候选者。
